narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous short created by synchronizing footage of a famous bronze monument at the Nijushi no Hitomi Movie Village with a popular Japanese meme song. The primary intent is to provide entertainment through the unexpected rhythmic matching of static, solemn statues to hyper-active J-pop music.
